text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: high evictions detected in gpu-pool-usw2-spot. queue_length trending up, autoscaler failing to add nodes. Paging @sara-oncall / @sre-team. incident id 2026-03-USW2-spot-01

sara-oncall: I'm on it. seeing 98% eviction rate on spot nodes starting 1972109600. Queue grew from 200 -> 1.6k in 9m. any recent deploys?

ajay: no deploys from infra in the last hour. I'm pulling autoscaler logs now.

jules: customer telemetry shows tail latency spikes and 429s from generation endpoints. major customers affected in us-west2. cc @emma-cs for outreach.

incident-bot: autoscaler attempts: 23 failures in last 10m, error=QuotaExceeded/InstanceTypeUnavailable. fallback_pool_policy attempted but returned 0 compatible nodes.

sara-oncall: checking cloud quotas + available GPU SKUs. kevin, can you check quota and spot capacity in the account?

kevin: quota looks fine at project level, but cloud reports NO_CAPACITY for A100s in us-west2 zone a/b. API shows preemptible pool exhausted. trying to request other SKUs (V100, T4).

ajay: autoscaler log excerpt:
```
E03015 19:06:24 scaler.go:214] scale up failed: ProviderError: unable to fulfill request: InstanceTypeUnavailable
E03015 19:07:02 scaler.go:198] retrying scale up, backoff=30s
E03015 19:07:32 scaler.go:214] scale up failed: QuotaExceeded: request would exceed project GPU quota
```

jules: looks like mixed failures: some AZs report capacity, others quota. fallback routing to dedicated pool didn't kick because label mismatch on node selector: `dedicated=true` vs `ml-dedicated:true` config drift.

sara-oncall: that would explain 0 nodes returned. Opening quick patch to fallback policy to accept either label. ajay, can you patch and apply? keep minimal change.

ajay: applying patch to policy config now. doing `kubectl -n infra edit cm fallback-policy` then rolling autoscaler.

deploy-bot: rollout started for config/fallback-policy (rev 2026.03.15-12).

kevin: meanwhile I requested capacity in adjacent region (us-west1) and started preemptible instances there to act as temporary capacity. routing rules will need update to prefer region fallback.

jules: customer impact summary so far: 8 customers showing >50% request errors in last 15m, 2 enterprise customers (org: Atlas & Scribe) have active incidents. Latency for embeddings up 3-4x.

emma-cs: I'm drafting outreach now. ETA for mitigation?

sara-oncall: estimate 12-18 minutes for fallback policy fix to propagate and for autoscaler to successfully attach available non-A100 nodes. If that fails we'll spool dedicated reserved capacity (manual attach) — kevin please standby for manual attach.

ajay: patch applied. autoscaler restarted: `systemctl restart redwood-autoscaler`. watching logs.

incident-bot: update: autoscaler reported new attempts. 6/10 scale attempts now returning Accepted on V100. however some pods still stuck in Pending because nodeSelector still references `gpu-type: a100`.

kevin: pushing small change to pod placement controller to accept `gpu-type: a100|v100` for inference pods. doing canary edit on one route.

jules: can we also lower min required GPU memory for low-priority queues so they can land on v100? quick config tweak: `request.gpu.memory: <=40GB` for low-priority.

ajay: making that tweak on the queue config. command:
```
redwood-cli queue update --name=preemptible-gen --low-priority-gpu-memory=40GB
```

sara-oncall: good. I'm seeing pods drain from Pending -> Running for low-priority ones. queue length down 1.2k -> 420 in 10m. tail latency improving.

emma-cs: sending update to affected customers: "We're experiencing transient capacity constraints in us-west2 due to spot interruptions; mitigation in progress. We'll follow up with a postmortem." asking for any org-specific notes?

kevin: manual attach ready if needed. started a 2-node dedicated pool (p-l1) and prepped firewall/KMS. will attach to routing if autoscaler can't reconcile in 20m.

jules: I'm seeing some request throttling still from internal rate limiter — probably backlog pressure. increasing worker concurrency for routing service by +20% for the next 30m.

ajay: autoscaler logs show successful provisioning of V100 preemptibles now. patch to nodeSelector completed across active revision. pods migrating.

incident-bot: Note: planned fallback used nodes with `preemptible` label; lifetime for those instances expected ~6h. Recommend follow-up action: schedule durable capacity if usage doesn't normalize.

sara-oncall: quick status: queue 420, errors trending down, critical customers engaged by CS, autoscaler healthy on new SKU, some manual dedicated capacity available but not attached. holding incident and monitoring for 30m. If no regression, will handoff to morning oncall.

kevin: attaching dedicated pool as precautionary measure now (manual attach completed). routing rules updated to include p-l1 with lower priority.

emma-cs: update sent to Atlas & Scribe. they acknowledged and asked for timeline for durable capacity; forwarding to sales/AMs.

jules: creating incident tracking doc and postmortem stub: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1972109999 (will populate root cause + timeline).

sara-oncall: thumbs. Preparing handoff. Current metrics snapshot:
- queue length: 380
- 5xx rate: 0.9% (down from 9%)
- avg latency: 620ms (down from 2.4s)
- autoscaler success rate: 86% last 10m

sara-oncall: Handoff to next oncall @ajay at 1972112800. Summary: cause = spot GPU exhaustion + config drift in fallback node labels + mixed quota/capacity errors. Mitigation = patched fallback policy, relaxed pod nodeSelector, increased worker concurrency, spun temporary V100 preemptibles and manual dedicated pool. Customers notified. Follow-ups: lock down fallback label scheme, add automated test for fallback_policy, consider reserved warm pool for peak windows.

ajay: taking handoff. I'll keep monitoring and begin follow-up epic for fallback label flakiness.

incident-bot: incident state: MONITORING -> awaiting final closure after 60m of stable metrics. incident severity: Sev2.

sara-oncall: thanks team. good coordination. :heart:

emma-cs: I'll keep CS loop informed and collect customer feedback for the postmortem.

ajay: logging the last log excerpt and closure notes into the incident doc then I'll update this thread when we close.

kevin: confirmed dedicated pool in place and healthy. tagging: @infra, @capacity-planning for follow-up.

deploy-bot: rollout completed for config/fallback-policy (rev 2026.03.15-12) - no rollbacks.

ajay: last check - metrics stable for 12m. If stable for another 48m I'll mark resolved.

sara-oncall: handing off to @ajay. leaving channel.

ajay: acknowledged. taking over monitoring.
